system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Fire. No item slots. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Proficiency[3], Soldier with Call of Respite

You have a crackling and wild roar that you can emanate in battle to steady your allies.

Ritualistic Call (Boost): When you use Call of Respite, you can always use Courage on the Trait Check, even when it is not relevant.

Rulebook p.47.
